metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: Like Ted Lasso and Community, this is a wholesome workplace comedy with a high-energy, optimistic ensemble cast.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: This matches your love for fast-paced sitcoms like New Girl and Scrubs, offering comfort with a fun police-procedural twist.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: Fans of Community and Silicon Valley will appreciate the rapid-fire jokes, meta-humor, and satire of the television industry.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: Similar to Peep Show and It's Always Sunny, this features a dysfunctional ensemble with complex, recurring jokes.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: This British classic aligns perfectly with Silicon Valley's tech humor and Peep Show's socially awkward comedy.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A mockumentary about vampires that captures the surreal, quirky humor found in Dirk Gently and The Good Place.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A perfect follow-up to King of the Hill and The Simpsons, offering a heart-filled family dynamic with quirky humor.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: If you enjoy the irreverent, adult-oriented sci-fi humor of Rick and Morty and Futurama, this spy-satire is a must-watch.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: Like Ted Lasso, this is a masterclass in the 'feel-good' genre, focusing on character growth and heartwarming comedy.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: Since you enjoy Gogglebox and MythBusters, this low-stakes, hilarious competition show is the ultimate 'comfort' reality TV.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: A cult British classic that shares the pop-culture obsession and meta-humor of Community and Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: This high-energy sitcom matches the chaotic group dynamic of Brassic and the nostalgic feel of Malcolm in the Middle.

metas.name: Spy x Family
metas.description: A lighthearted anime that blends action with wholesome family comedy, perfect for fans of One-Punch Man and One Piece.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: Created by the same author as One-Punch Man, it balances spectacular action with a very sweet, comedic coming-of-age story.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: Matches the 'Sci-Fi meets Comedy' vibe of Futurama and Doctor Who, serving as both a parody and a love letter to the genre.

metas.name: Ghosts (UK)
metas.description: A charming, lighthearted ensemble comedy that fits the afterlife/supernatural themes of The Good Place.

metas.name: Broad City
metas.description: Like It's Always Sunny and New Girl, this focuses on chaotic friendships and hilarious urban misadventures.

metas.name: Curb Your Enthusiasm
metas.description: If you enjoy the 'cringe' and social observation of Peep Show and It's Always Sunny, Larry David's series is essential.

metas.name: Resident Alien
metas.description: Blending Sci-Fi, mystery, and comedy, this matches the quirky energy of Dirk Gently and Fallout.

metas.name: Red Dwarf
metas.description: A legendary British sci-fi sitcom that should appeal to fans of Futurama's space-faring adventures and Peep Show's humor.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: Captures the fun, swashbuckling adventure of One Piece with the warmth and humor of Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Solar Opposites
metas.description: Created by the co-creator of Rick and Morty, this provides the same sci-fi absurdity and fast-paced animation style.

metas.name: Superstore
metas.description: A reliable 'background' comfort show that shares the workplace ensemble magic of Scrubs and Parks and Rec.

metas.name: Extraordinary
metas.description: A fresh British comedy about a world where everyone has superpowers; it's as funny and inventive as The Good Place.

metas.name: Star Trek: Lower Decks
metas.description: An animated comedy that explores the less-important crew members in space, perfect for fans of Futurama.

metas.name: Nathan for You
metas.description: A highly unique comedy that captures the awkward social tension of Peep Show in a 'business' reality format.

metas.name: Black Books
metas.description: A quintessential British sitcom with a cynical edge that will appeal to fans of Peep Show and Goodness Gracious Me.

metas.name: Modern Family
metas.description: A classic 'easy watch' that fills the family-dynamic void left by Malcolm in the Middle and The Simpsons.

metas.name: Happy Endings
metas.description: A hidden gem sitcom with incredibly fast jokes and a tight-knit friend group like New Girl and Community.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A very light, uplifting, and funny sitcom about a family-run store that provides excellent 'comfort' viewing.

metas.name: Detroiters
metas.description: A hidden gem about two best friends that is incredibly silly, pure-hearted, and funny, matching the Ted Lasso vibe.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: A dry, musical comedy about two New Zealanders in NYC, matching the quirky comedic sensibilities of Community.

metas.name: The Venture Bros.
metas.description: Like Rick and Morty and One-Punch Man, this parodies superhero and sci-fi tropes with brilliant writing and world-building.

metas.name: Inside Job
metas.description: An animated workplace comedy about conspiracy theories that fits perfectly with the humor of Futurama and Rick and Morty.

metas.name: Garth Marenghi's Darkplace
metas.description: A cult British parody of 80s horror/sci-fi shows; its bizarre and meta humor is a great match for Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A cynical but hilarious look at catering staff in LA, perfect for fans of Silicon Valley and Always Sunny.

metas.name: Stath Lets Flats
metas.description: A socially awkward, character-driven British comedy that fans of Peep Show and Brassic will find hilarious.

metas.name: Fresh Meat
metas.description: From the creators of Peep Show, this explores a group of students living together with the same sharp, awkward humor.

metas.name: Mythic Quest
metas.description: A workplace comedy set in a video game studio, bridging the gap between Silicon Valley and It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: The Middle
metas.description: A very grounded and relatable family sitcom that serves as a spiritual successor to Malcolm in the Middle.
